content_sections.heading: About IIT Delhi Principal Project Scientist
content_sections.text: The Industrial Research & Development Unit of the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, located at Hauz Khas, New Delhi, has announced a project appointment for the School of Public Policy. The position supports the project titled "Support to Indian Institute of Technology Delhi for Enhancing Indias Science Technology Policy Analysis Capabilities." funded by R D Tata Trust, Mumbai.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is 1 vacancy available for the post under the project. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Principal Project Scientist position must meet the essential educational qualification and experience criteria specified in the official notification. Deep familiarity with, and understanding of, sustainability transitions as well as technological innovation. Deep understanding of climate policy and low-carbon development in both Indian as well as global context. Engagement with Indian and/or global climate policy entities. Demonstrated capacity to produce high-quality academic publications as well as policy reports. Please also attach a small statement indicating how you meet all the essential experience criteria.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in social sciences OR outstanding researcher with 1st class postgraduate degree in social science/natural science and having a minimum of 6 years of research experience.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated fellowship slab for the Principal Project Scientist is Rs. 75,600 - 77,870 - 80,210 - 82,620 - 85,100 - 87,650 - 90,280 - 92,900 - 95,780 - 98,650 - 1,01,010/- p.m. plus HRA @30%. The appointment is on a contractual basis with consolidated pay, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier, up to 28-02-2030. A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates in case of selection of a retired/superannuated government employee, whose salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates from those satisfying advertised qualification and requirement of the project post and their name will be displayed on web link (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted) along with the online interview details. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for online interview. In case any clarification is required on eligibility regarding the above post, the candidate may contact Prof. Ambuj D. Sagar at email id: [email protected]
